data.name: Sunita
data.gender_notes: Sunita is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + nī, 'to lead' — 'well-conducted'. Its root is Sanskrit su + nī. A classical Sanskrit name. Sunita is a Sanskrit name meaning “Well-conducted; of good character”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sunita expresses “Well-conducted; of good character”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + nī, 'to lead' — 'well-conducted'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunita total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
